info.title: MyVisApp API
info.description:
Frontend integration contract for the MyVisApp travel and visa platform.

All application routes start with `/api/v1`. Use **Authorize** with an access JWT
for operations marked with `bearerAuth`; public authentication and catalogue
operations do not require a bearer token. Refresh and email/invitation tokens
belong in the documented request body, not in the Authorization header.

JSON successes use `ApiResponse` (`success`, `message`, `data`, `timestamp`).
Document downloads return binary data with a Content-Disposition filename.
Errors use `ApiErrorResponse`: inspect HTTP status and `code`, and display
`message` and any `validationErrors`. Common statuses are 400 (invalid input),
401 (authentication/token failure), 403 (permission/account restrictions),
404 (missing or hidden resource), 409 (conflict), 413 (upload size),
422 (business rule) and 500 (unexpected/storage failure).

UUID path parameters identify persisted records. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD;
timestamps include a timezone, for example 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z.
Pagination is zero-based; each operation describes its limits and ordering.
The server applies ownership and organisation checks in addition to authority
rules. An inaccessible tenant resource may return 404 to avoid disclosure.

Email links require configured mail delivery and frontend routes. Successful
email-triggering requests do not guarantee delivery; messages are sent after commit.
Operation descriptions identify current feature limitations, including catalogue
version replacement and initial submission completeness checks.

put.description: Adds the existing role to the user's global roles. Assigning a role already present leaves the assignment unchanged. The returned profile includes the resulting role codes. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('USER_UPDATE') and hasAuthority('PERMISSION_ASSIGN').

delete.description: Removes the role from the user's global roles. Removing roles from your own account is disallowed. Returns the resulting account profile. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('USER_UPDATE') and hasAuthority('PERMISSION_ASSIGN').

put.summary: Assign a permission to a role
put.description: Adds an existing permission to a global role. Repeating an existing assignment does not duplicate it. Returns the role and its resulting permission codes. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('ROLE_UPDATE') and hasAuthority('PERMISSION_ASSIGN').

delete.summary: Remove a permission from a role
delete.description: Removes an existing permission from a global role and returns the resulting role. Changes are recorded in the audit log when an assignment actually changes. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('ROLE_UPDATE') and hasAuthority('PERMISSION_ASSIGN').

put.description: Adds an existing permission to a role belonging to this organisation. Requires organisation-scoped ORGANISATION_MANAGE or TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS. Roles from another organisation are not accepted. Requires a bearer access token.

delete.description: Removes a permission from an organisation-scoped role. Requires organisation-scoped ORGANISATION_MANAGE or TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS. Returns the updated role and permission codes. Requires a bearer access token.

put.description: Adds a role from this organisation to the selected membership. Requires organisation-scoped ORGANISATION_MANAGE or TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS. Returns the resulting membership. Requires a bearer access token.

delete.description: Removes an organisation role from a membership. Removing your own organisation role is disallowed. Requires organisation-scoped ORGANISATION_MANAGE or TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS. Requires a bearer access token.

put.description: Updates the application's processing priority and dueAt timestamp. Requires scoped APPLICATION_UPDATE access or cross-tenant access. Send timestamps with a timezone, for example 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_UPDATE').

Assigns an ACTIVE user as reviewer and records assignment history. Requires both endpoint authorities plus scoped assignment access or cross-tenant access. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAllAuthorities('APPLICATION_ASSIGN','APPLICATION_REVIEW').

Assigns an ACTIVE user as processing officer and records assignment history. Requires the application organisation's APPLICATION_ASSIGN permission or cross-tenant access in addition to the endpoint authority. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_ASSIGN').

get.description: Returns checklist items and completion information for the application. Requires scoped APPLICATION_READ_ALL or cross-tenant access in addition to the endpoint authority. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_READ_ALL').

put.description: Creates an item for a new code or updates the existing item's completed state, recording completion actor/time. Existing item labels are retained. Requires scoped APPLICATION_CHECKLIST_UPDATE or cross-tenant access. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_CHECKLIST_UPDATE').

Replaces the current answer set using questionCode/value entries, validates against the selected definition and preserves answer revisions. Omitted previous answers are superseded, so send the complete intended set. Allowed only in DRAFT or CORRECTION_REQUIRED with ownership/scoped access. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_UPDATE').

get.description: Returns account summaries in data.content with Spring Page metadata. Pagination is zero-based; the default is 20 records sorted by createdAt descending. Supports page, size and sort parameters. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('USER_READ').

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

post.description: Creates an account pending email verification and issues a verification email when delivery is enabled. Does not assign a role automatically; use the role-assignment endpoint separately. Duplicate email addresses conflict. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('USER_CREATE').

Sets the account to SUSPENDED. Administrators cannot suspend their own account. Records the status change in the audit log. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('USER_DISABLE').

Sets the account to DISABLED. Administrators cannot disable their own account. Records the status change in the audit log. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('USER_DISABLE').

Reactivates an email-verified account and clears login lock state. Email verification is a prerequisite; this endpoint does not verify email on the user's behalf. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('USER_UPDATE').

get.description: Returns global role definitions and their permission codes. Organisation-scoped roles are managed through the organisation endpoints instead. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('USER_READ').

post.description: Creates a role with a normalized code, name and optional description. Duplicate codes or names conflict. Assign permissions using the separate permission-assignment endpoint. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('ROLE_CREATE').

Creates a real organisation immediately with PENDING status for internal administrator provisioning. Applicant self-registration uses the separate organisation-registration workflow. Activate the organisation through its activation endpoint. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('ORGANISATION_MANAGE') and hasAuthority('TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS').

get.description: Returns roles belonging to this organisation with their permission codes. Requires organisation-scoped ORGANISATION_MANAGE or TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS. Requires a bearer access token.

post.description: Creates a role scoped to the organisation; its code must be unique within that organisation. Requires organisation-scoped ORGANISATION_MANAGE or TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS. Requires a bearer access token.

get.description: Returns memberships with user IDs, email addresses, active flags and organisation-role codes, ordered by creation time. Requires organisation-scoped ORGANISATION_MANAGE or TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS. Requires a bearer access token.

post.summary: Add or reactivate an organisation member
post.description: Adds an existing user or reactivates their existing membership and adds the supplied organisation roles. This does not replace existing roles or create a user account. Requires organisation-scoped ORGANISATION_MANAGE or TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS. Requires a bearer access token.

Sets an existing organisation to ACTIVE. Requires TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS. This is internal provisioning, separate from approval of a pending registration. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS').

get.description: By default returns only the caller's registrations. reviewQueue=true requires both ORGANISATION_MANAGE and TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS and returns email-verified registrations awaiting approval. Zero-based page, fixed 25 records per page, oldest first. Requires a bearer access token.

post.description: Creates a separate pending registration for the signed-in account using code and name. Does not create the organisation. Review requires verified applicant email; the response exposes the current registration status. Requires a bearer access token.

Requires both ORGANISATION_MANAGE and TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS, verified applicant email and a pending registration. Records the supplied reason and reviewer without creating an organisation. Rejection is a final review outcome for this registration. Requires a bearer access token.

Requires both ORGANISATION_MANAGE and TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS and a pending registration with verified applicant email. Atomically creates an ACTIVE organisation and the applicant's scoped administrator membership. Already-reviewed registrations cannot be reviewed again; conflicting organisation code/name prevents approval. Requires a bearer access token.

get.description: Returns staff-only notes in a Spring Page, newest first. Requires scoped APPLICATION_NOTE_INTERNAL or cross-tenant access. Do not display these notes in customer-facing screens. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_NOTE_INTERNAL').

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

post.description: Creates a staff-only note with the authenticated author and timestamp. Requires scoped APPLICATION_NOTE_INTERNAL or cross-tenant access. These notes are separate from applicantNotes. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_NOTE_INTERNAL').

Creates an information request with message and optional dueAt and queues a notification. When the current workflow permits, also moves the application to AWAITING_ADDITIONAL_INFORMATION; that transition additionally requires APPLICATION_CHANGE_STATUS. Requires scoped request-information access or cross-tenant access. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_REQUEST_INFORMATION').

Creates a client owned by the signed-in family manager with relationship metadata. The nested traveller.selfManaged value does not change that ownership. Neither consent nor a separate traveller account is required; the returned clientId works with normal application and document APIs. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('CLIENT_CREATE').

post.summary: Invite an adult for consent or migration
post.description: Only the current family manager can issue an invitation. Requires an adult aged 18+ and the traveller's own email, different from the manager's. purpose is CONSENT or MIGRATION. A new invitation replaces the previous one, expires in 48 hours and is emailed after commit when delivery is enabled; raw tokens are not returned. Both actions remain optional. Requires a bearer access token.

delete.description: Only the current family manager can invalidate the outstanding invitation. Cancellation does not remove the traveller, change consent already recorded or migrate an account. Requires a bearer access token.

post.description: Send a MIGRATION invitation token while signed into the adult traveller's matching verified ACTIVE account. Consent is not required. Transfers the existing client and applications owned by the family manager, preserving IDs and document links. Other parties' applications retain their ownership. The invitation is single-use and former family ownership access ends. Requires a bearer access token.

get.description: Filters by search text, nationality and countryOfResidence within the caller's accessible records. Supports zero-based page and size; size is clamped to 1-100 and sorting is fixed to newest created first. Returns a custom page object inside data. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('CLIENT_READ').

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

post.description: Creates a client/traveller record. selfManaged defaults to true and makes the caller the owner. false creates a staff-managed record and additionally requires CLIENT_MANAGE_ALL plus TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS. Use the family-member endpoint when relationship and optional consent/migration features are needed. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('CLIENT_CREATE').

Send multipart/form-data with a file part and categoryCode query parameter; issueDate and expiryDate are optional YYYY-MM-DD query parameters. Requires client ownership or authorised staff/organisation access. Returns document-version metadata with 201, not the file bytes. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('DOCUMENT_UPLOAD').

Consumes the single-use email verification token from the email link and verifies the account. Organisation registrations then become eligible for business review; verification itself does not approve an organisation. No access tokens are returned. Public; no bearer token required.
Consumes the reset token and stores the new password. Revokes all refresh tokens for the user. No login tokens are returned; sign in again with the new password. Public; no bearer token required.

Creates a CUSTOMER account pending email verification. Sends a single-use verification link when email delivery is enabled. Does not return login tokens; verify the email before login. Duplicate email addresses conflict. Public; no bearer token required.

Send the refresh token in the JSON body. Returns a new access/refresh pair and invalidates the previous refresh token. Reuse of a revoked token revokes its token family. Replace the stored refresh token after every successful response. Public; no bearer token required.

Public registration with nested applicant and organisation objects. Creates a personal account and separate pending registration, then issues the normal email verification link. No organisation or membership is created until approval. Existing account holders should use authenticated registration submission. Public; no bearer token required.

Revokes the refresh token supplied in the body. An unknown nonblank token is ignored. This does not immediately revoke an already-issued access JWT; discard both tokens on the client. Public; no bearer token required.

Checks email, password and account availability, then returns an access token, refresh token, token type and access-token lifetime. Unverified, suspended or disabled accounts cannot sign in; repeated failed attempts temporarily lock the account. Public; no bearer token required.

Accepts an email address and returns the same generic success message whether or not an eligible account exists. Sends a reset link when email delivery is enabled. Do not infer account existence from the response. Public; no bearer token required.

Public token-based action. Send the emailed CONSENT token and granted=true or false to record consent or refusal/withdrawal. The token is single-use and email-bound. This never transfers ownership or gates normal family management; use an explicit frontend confirmation rather than submitting automatically on link opening. Public; no bearer token required.

get.description: Lists applications within the caller's access scope, optionally filtered by status. Zero-based page and size, size clamped to 1-100, newest created first. Returns a custom page object inside data. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAnyAuthority('APPLICATION_READ_OWN','APPLICATION_READ_ALL').

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

post.description: Creates a DRAFT application for clientId and an active visaDefinitionId. The caller becomes the application owner and the client's managing organisation is inherited. Requires access to the traveller; keeps the selected definition version for this application's lifetime. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_CREATE').

Only the application owner can call this operation. DRAFT advances to INITIAL_INFORMATION_SUBMITTED; the next valid call advances to INITIAL_DOCUMENTS_SUBMITTED. Optional body contains comment. This currently checks state/permission transitions but does not verify that all required answers and documents are complete. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_UPDATE').

Requests an allowed transition with status and optional reason. Backend transition rules enforce the current state and the required change-status/review permission. Records status history and audit/notification events; arbitrary status jumps are rejected. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAnyAuthority('APPLICATION_CHANGE_STATUS','APPLICATION_REVIEW').

Sets the assigned user after application access checks and emits an assignment notification. For the internal workflow with active-assignee validation and assignment-history records, use PUT /api/v1/internal/applications/{id}/officer. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_ASSIGN').

Send multipart/form-data with a file part and categoryCode query parameter; issueDate and expiryDate are optional YYYY-MM-DD query parameters. Requires application access. Returns document-version metadata with 201; the server manages encrypted storage and versioning. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('DOCUMENT_UPLOAD').

Links an existing reusable document version to the application after access checks. Send versionId in the URL with no file upload body. Returns the attached version's metadata. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('DOCUMENT_UPLOAD').

post.summary: Create a complete visa definition draft
post.description: Creates the definition plus nested requirements, questions, question options and rules in one request. At least one question is required; code and version must be unique together. destinationCountry is a two-letter code and visaCategory is text. No draft-edit or individual child-item CRUD endpoint exists; supply a complete new version for revisions. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('VISA_CATALOGUE_MANAGE').

Validates rules, activates the selected definition and deactivates active versions of the same code. Existing applications retain their original definition reference. No separate deactivation endpoint is currently exposed. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('VISA_CATALOGUE_MANAGE').

get.description: Returns an account profile, status, verification information and assigned global role codes. Password hashes and authentication tokens are never returned. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('USER_READ').

patch.description: Updates firstName, lastName and phoneNumber using the supplied profile payload. This endpoint does not change email, password, roles or account status. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('USER_UPDATE').
Updates the role's name and description. Does not change its code or assigned permissions. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('ROLE_UPDATE').

get.description: Returns the traveller's details after ownership, organisation CLIENT_READ or cross-tenant checks. A client ID identifies the traveller record, not a login account. Inaccessible organisation-managed records are hidden with 404. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('CLIENT_READ').

patch.description: Updates supplied non-null fields; omitted or null fields retain their existing values. Requires ownership, organisation CLIENT_UPDATE or cross-tenant access in addition to the endpoint permission. Does not transfer ownership. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('CLIENT_UPDATE').

get.description: Returns application details within owner, organisation or cross-tenant access. Inaccessible organisation-managed applications are hidden with 404. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAnyAuthority('APPLICATION_READ_OWN','APPLICATION_READ_ALL').

patch.description: Updates applicantNotes subject to owner/organisation/cross-tenant access. This endpoint does not change the traveller, selected definition, answers or processing status. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_UPDATE').

get.description: Public list of active definition summaries ordered by destination country and name. Returns IDs, country codes, offering codes, names, categories, descriptions and versions. The frontend can group by destination; no separate country/type master-list endpoint or server-side catalogue filter is available. Public; no bearer token required.

Public lookup by offering code, returning its active version, processing information, requirements, questions, options and conditional rules. Use the returned definition ID when creating an application. An unknown code or a code without an active version returns 404. Public; no bearer token required.

Returns the authenticated account profile, verification and MFA flags, status and effective permission codes. Use the permission codes to control frontend actions; backend access checks still apply. Requires a bearer access token.

Returns permission IDs, codes, names and descriptions sorted by code. Use the IDs for role-permission assignment requests. This endpoint does not create permissions. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('USER_READ').
Returns organisation code, name and status. Requires organisation-scoped ORGANISATION_MANAGE or TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS; inaccessible organisations are hidden with 404. Requires a bearer access token.

Lists applications within authorised organisations or cross-tenant scope. Filters include status, visaType (the definition's visaCategory), country (two-letter destination), officer, organisation, submittedFrom inclusive, submittedTo exclusive, priority and overdue. Date filters currently use application creation time. Zero-based pagination, size 1-100, newest first. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('APPLICATION_READ_ALL').

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

get.description: Returns relationship, consentGrantedAt and migratedAt for a client. Only the current client owner can read this metadata; after migration the former manager no longer has ownership access. Requires a bearer access token.

Returns raw file bytes using the stored content type and Content-Disposition attachment filename, not an ApiResponse JSON envelope. versionId is the document-version UUID. Requires authorised access to the traveller and requested version; errors remain JSON. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAnyAuthority('DOCUMENT_READ_OWN','DOCUMENT_READ_ALL').

200.description: File bytes; filename is supplied in Content-Disposition

get.description: Returns the application's status timeline after application access checks. Use this history to show progress rather than deriving past states from the current status. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAnyAuthority('APPLICATION_READ_OWN','APPLICATION_READ_ALL').

Returns the application's pinned definition version, questions, current answers and evaluated visibility/required state. Use these rules to render the form; the server validates answers independently. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAnyAuthority('APPLICATION_READ_OWN','APPLICATION_READ_ALL').

Returns paged additional-information requests for the owner or a cross-tenant user, newest first. Other callers receive 404. This endpoint lists requests; it does not mark them answered. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAnyAuthority('APPLICATION_READ_OWN','APPLICATION_READ_ALL').

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

get.description: Returns raw file bytes using the stored content type and Content-Disposition attachment filename. versionId must be linked to the accessible application. Configure the frontend HTTP client for a binary/blob response; errors remain JSON. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAnyAuthority('DOCUMENT_READ_OWN','DOCUMENT_READ_ALL').

200.description: File bytes; filename is supplied in Content-Disposition

get.summary: Get any visa definition by ID
get.description: Returns the complete configuration for an active, inactive or draft definition, including requirements and questions with options/rules. Requires the definition UUID; an admin list/search endpoint is not currently exposed. Requires a bearer access token. Authority rule: hasAuthority('VISA_CATALOGUE_MANAGE').

delete.description: Marks the membership inactive without deleting the user account. Deactivating your own membership is disallowed. Requires organisation-scoped ORGANISATION_MANAGE or TENANT_ACCESS_CROSS. Requires a bearer access token.
